item.title: This is my personal favorite pics of you guys. It looks dreamy, cute, fun and romantic.
item.description:
Dear CS, congratulations on finding your forever person. The one who you can lean on. The one who you can talk anything about. Someone you call HOME. I'm super duper triple happy for youuu.


I wish you a lifetime of love, laughter, happiness and countless beautiful memories together. May your marriage be filled with patience on difficult days, endless laughter on ordinary days, and a love that grows stronger with every passing year. Always remember that marriage isn't about finding someone perfect, but about choosing and love each other everyday, even on the imperfect days.


Some reminder for you guys that i found on tiktok for myself, but i wanna share it with you guys too.


  1. Never stop dating each other.

  2. Communicate, even if it's uncomfortable.

  3. Never go to bed with a heart full of resentment.

  4. Choose understanding over winning.

  5. Be each other's safe place.


I think that's all i can say to you guys and hope it also becomes the Unspoken Rules in your marriage. Can't wait for the big day guyss!!


Oh right, almost forgot to give some wishes to Epseen too HAHAHAHAH. The first time i met you, i think you're a good guy and patient as well. You guys are lucky to find each other. CS is the stubborn childish one and you're the mature patient one ahahahahah. Anyway, i hope you'll always be patient with her, take care of her and love her everyday til she's old and full of wrinkles. If someday you hurt her, it's not me who you should be worried about, her dad might kill you :)


See you on November 21st guyss!!


Xoxo, San

item.title: dear Epseen and ACEES

item.title: We will always be supporting both of you! 🫶
item.description:
Hi Cees, temen kuliahku dari semester 1 😊 dari awal kenal sama km, menurutku km orangnya sangat2 cheerful, selalu mau membantu, always supporting, and very kind…


Aku nda pernah nyangka kalau km yg nikah duluan diantara kita2. Awal2 dpt info km udah engaged, jujur aku seneng bgt krn dr kapan hari udah selalu gangguin km and epseen “kapan nikah?” pas jalan bareng kita2 temen kuliah km.


Cees and epseen, wishing you both a greatful journey ahead yaah, semoga setiap harinya dilewati dengan moment yang shining shimmering splendid.


Actually i dont really know what marriage advice to give, tapi aku yakin communication is the key, dan kalian berdua jago di hal itu. Jd aku 100% sure kehidupan rumah tangga kalian akan lancar 😇 Also guys, aku pernah denger juga dari beberapa orang yang sudah married kalau both sides akan sama2 terkejut dengan habits pasangannya after marriage. Jadi, jangan lupa untuk saling memahami yaa!


I am super happy for both of you. For cees, kalau butuh tempat cerita even after being a wife, please bgt diceritain yaa, aku terbuka untuk cerita2 apapun itu. Remember jangan dipendam 😊 For epseen, tolong dijaga yaa cees temen baik aku. Aku yakin km anak baik dan sayang bgt sama cees, pasti km bisa jaga dia terus sampai selamanya.



With Love,

Hayo tebak

item.title: Met nikahhhh !! 🤍
item.description:
First of all congratulations for your wedding! Im so happy and thrilled for you both! Semoga di sepanjang perjalanan hidup kalian Tuhan slalu menyertai dan memimpin rumah tangga kalian, saling menyayangi, mengasihi dan mengerti satu sama lain.


Harapan dan advice ku untuk kalian adalah utamakan Tuhan dalam kehidupan keluarga kalian sehingga kiranya kasih, sukacita dan damai sejahtera slalu ada dalam rumah tangga kalian dan juga saling mengerti dan memahami satu sama lain, apapun yang akan kalian hadapin ke depannya baik senang maupun susah smoga Tuhan buat berhasil.


May God bless you and your family 🤍

Dear Ces, Congratulations on your wedding ya! Wishing you lots of love and a lifetime of happiness ❤️


Layaknya merpati putih sebagai subjek pesan ini, semoga rumah tangga kalian senantiasa dipenuhi keharmonisan dan kesetiaan sampai akhir hayat ya.


Actually I don't know mau ngasih advice apa sebab terakhir aku putus aja putusnya sama tali plasenta wkwkwk 🤡


Tapi what i can say adalah, marriage is about commitment & marriage has to be 100-100. So, both of you must give your all to your household. Jadikan rumah tangga kalian as top priority di atas segala kepentingan lainnya & selalu jaga komunikasi kalian bahkan di saat tersulit sekalipun.

Selain commitment & 100% effort, respect each other is a must ya!

Actually, I heard this advice dari para tetua lol 🫤 cuz seiring dengan bertambahnya usia pernikahan dan manis pahit yang dilalui, terkadang kita bisa mandang sebelah mata effort pasangan kita & if that happens maka hubungan gak akan harmonis lagi.


I wont say epseen tolong jaga ces ya, or ces tolong jaga epseen ya cuz both of you HARUS saling menjaga, mengasihi, memahami & menghormati satu sama lain dengan porsi yang sama besarnya.


Last but not least, may the love you feel on your wedding day only grow deeper through the years ahead 🤍


Xoxo,

Mel

item.title: Cheers to the happy couple! 🥂
item.description:
Hi Cees, congratulations on getting married! Having known you for the past 13 years, I’m so glad you’ve finally found the one.


To Epseen, although we’ve never met, you’ve made an impeccable choice by choosing to spend your life with her.


I’m sorry I won’t be there to celebrate this special day with you, but I’m praying that God will keep your hearts united and continue to write a beautiful story through your marriage until death do you part.


There’s a little reminder I received many years ago that I’d love to pass on to you both: Make big problems smaller, and don’t let small problems become problems at all. May this be a little reminder to always approach life’s challenges together with love, patience, and understanding.


Once again, congratulations on your wedding. May God bless your marriage abundantly!


Warmest regards,
Jo
